title: console: an api-type action target with `${ctx.recordId}` is sent uninterpolated (`…/$%7Bctx.recordId%7D`) — url targets interpolate, api targets do not
body:
Filing gate: ① product defect, reproduced, landing site named.
Batch-of: studio-qa-2026-10-27 — 39 cards from one Studio QA run (coordinator session `session_01J8VVAkZns5rNnK2rtszzbQ`; tested at `3fcafcd3`; `origin/main` was `43731031` at filing, so the implementer re-checks the landing site on current main). The run record is the `qa-run` issue filed with this batch.

## Symptom

The spec documents `${ctx.recordId}` for api targets, but the request goes out with the literal placeholder, so the call hits a nonexistent record.

## Reproduction

1. Action `call_api` on `gapdata_item`: `type: "api"`, `target: "/api/v1/data/gapdata_item/${ctx.recordId}"`, method PATCH → click on a record → network: `PATCH /api/v1/data/gapdata_item/$%7Bctx.recordId%7D`.
2. Action `export_tab` (POST, same placeholder) → `POST …/$%7Bctx.recordId%7D`.
3. Control: a `type: "url"` action with the same placeholder opens the interpolated URL.

## Expected

api targets interpolate the same context variables as url targets.

## Suspected landing site (the implementer verifies)

The console action runner for `type: "api"` (`ui/` action executor).

## Filing facts

- reach: Console UI, measured twice by the data gap-fill card.
- Business reason: Record-level API actions cannot be built without code; they fail on every record.
- Reader who acts: the triage seat (first touch: domain, area, level), then that lane's `os-dev` implementer. QA suggestion only: `domain:ui`, `area:records`, p2.
- Dedupe: semantic search `api action target ctx.recordId not interpolated in request path` on objectstack-ai/objectstack → 0 hits.
- QA id: G6
